mu_name_from: MuMain loads glove indexes 10 to 14 from GloveElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 151: `AccessModel(MODEL_GLOVES + i + 10, ..., L"GloveElf", i + 1)`), so index 11 is GloveElf02, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Silk Gloves. Group 10 index 11, Player/GloveElf02.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's second set, and the first one she can buy: Elf Lala in Noria carries all five pieces at +2 (src/sim/market.cpp, kElfLala, the index-11 rows). Here so that her shelf shows the pieces it sells rather than their names.
profile_from: Not armour, whose default is plate_steel: nothing in this set is a forged plate. The sheets are violet quilted fabric with gold flourishes painted into it, which is the Pad set's reading - stuffed cloth, not a plate - in the elf's colours. See profiles/soft_armour.json.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 115. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateGloves(number, name, dropLevel, defense, attackSpeed, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). Slot 5, so `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)` makes the group 10.
stats.attack_speed_note: Recorded and unread: shared/Combat.cs takes attack speed off the weapon row alone.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. 70 agility beside thirty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/gloves_c07.OZJ (64x64) and hide.jpg, from MuMain. The .bmd names gloves_c07.jpg and hide.jpg; 140 of the 146 triangles are on the first and 6 on hide. Note the c leads here (gloves_c07) where the Vine and Wind sheets trail it (gloves_04c, gloves_09c) - MU's spelling, kept.
sheet_note: gloves_c07 is a violet quilted glove from two sides with a gilt bar across the back of the hand and a gilt cap at the cuff. Mean (139, 114, 127) at chroma 39; the pale ground around the two gloves lifts the mean. hide caps the opening.
material_note: cloth on both islands, the two gloves (72 and 74 - gloves_c07's 140 and hide's 6). The gilt bar across the back of the hand and the cuff cap are a small part of each island; the rest is violet quilting, so the island reads as fabric, where the Pad Gloves took brass because their gilt plate was most of the sheet.
